text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
え？　
うわぁーー！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Hiyori! Are you okay?!
...What's going on?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ヒヨリちゃん！？　
……
何、
これ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
It's not some sort of curtain, right?
Black mist...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
カーテン、
じゃないよね？　
黒い霧……？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! It's pitch-black!
I can't see a thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ！　
辺り一面真っ暗だ！　
何も見えない！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て！　
霧が晴れてくよ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Are they... Are they all merging together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
融合……
してるとでもいうのか……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Something's sucking them all in!
Over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何かに吸い込まれてる！　
あれは……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hey. Isn't that the kagami mochi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえ二人とも。
あれ、
鏡餅じゃない？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
This is what the priest meant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか！　
これが司祭様の言ってた……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: They interweave and entwine, leading to dramatic results!
